checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must.why: The clip runs about 10 s, but it is 16:9 landscape, not vertical.

must.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must.why: Only three photos were supplied. The storefront and croissant display are recognizable. The leaf latte photo is not seen in the sampled frames. The interior and barista scenes are invented, not from supplied photos.

must.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must.why: The storefront is seen at 1 s and the croissants at 9.6 s. The latte photo is not seen at all.

must.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must.why: Audio is present with a peak of -2.3 dB. The content cannot be judged. The reply says ambient café sound, not music.

must.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must.why: No added text is visible in the frames. Transitions are not directly visible, but the sampled frames show no obvious glitches.

faults.what: The latte-art photo is missing from the sampled frames. It was replaced by invented scenes.
The interior and barista scenes were invented. The user never supplied those photos, and the reply claims they were used.
The output is 16:9 landscape, not a vertical reel.
The reply claims five photos were used, but only three were attached. It does not mention this mismatch.
The croissant scene's layout differs from the supplied photo. The storefront has a slightly changed shape, and 'LA' text appears at the right edge.

summary: A clean-looking 10 s landscape café clip came out, but it is not vertical, the latte photo is missing, and two scenes were invented from photos the user never supplied.
